race.title: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap (Div 1)
race.verdict: MR MOONSHINE went like the best horse at the weights when runner-up at Southwell on his most recent outing, doing all he could from a hopeless position, and is plainly one to be interested in again. Fleur de Mer arrives in good order and heads up the opposition, along with Annandale , who could easily get back on track resuming from another break. MR MOONSHINE (IRE) FLEUR DE MER (IRE) ANNANDALE (IRE)
race.bettingForecast: Mr Moonshine (9/4), West Tyrone (7/2), Fleur De Mer (4/1), Dream Harder (8/1), Annandale (8/1), Prince Achille (10/1), Naval Command (14/1), Chicago Storm (16/1), Beckon (50/1)
